room_rent.note: No room-rent sub-limit in base In-Patient Treatment; optional 'Change in Room Rent Limits' (3.7.5) can set a cap; Rs1000/day Accommodation Bonus if twin-sharing or lower

icu.note: ICU charges paid under base hospitalisation; no cap stated

copayment.note: No mandatory base co-pay; co-pay only if opted in schedule (cl.6.6 / Voluntary Co-payment 3.7.x)

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise capping in base; Modern Treatment limited per schedule

ped_waiting.note: Excl01; reducible to 24 or 12 months via optional add-on (3.7.x)

maternity.note: Maternity Cover (3.7.13.1) optional; waiting per schedule; includes Newborn & Infertility add-ons

cumulative_bonus.note: Inbuilt Cumulative Bonus (3.5.1): 33.33% of Base SI/claim-free yr; reduced 33.33% after a claim

restoration.note: Inbuilt Unlimited Reinstatement of Base SI (3.2.1), related & unrelated, unlimited times

ambulance.note: Road + intercity ambulance (3.1.2) up to schedule limit

global_cover.note: VERIFY: no clear overseas/global cover found in wording

notable_exclusions.display: Standard IRDAI exclusions (Excl01-18); domiciliary excludes listed chronic conditions; maternity & consumables need add-ons

optional_riders.display: Maternity/Newborn/Infertility, Consumables, Change in Room Rent, PED waiting reduction, Voluntary Co-pay, Short Stay, Hospital Cash, Double Cover
